2034-4772-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4772-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2645-2872-3430-5621.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2872-3430-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5240-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2493-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2493-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
2493-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Archaeomancer and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

628-728-3108.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.
628-728-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

997-7388--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

1636-2681-3181-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

64-2104-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Warden of the Eye.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Warden of the Eye from exile to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

101-1987-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
101-1987-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
101-1987-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1409-3099-4289-5434.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1170-5790-7495.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls more lands than you.
1170-5790-7495.description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, targeting Beza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skycoach Conductor, causing it to enter prepared.
Resolve All Aboard, blinking Beza.
When Beza enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure token, two 1/1 Fish creature tokens if an opponent controls more creatures than you, causing you to gain 4 life if an opponent has more life than you, and causing you to draw a card if an opponent has more cards in hand than you.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2438-4535--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-4029-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Benevolent Hydra and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

240-413-1849-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

628-2921-7212.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

1594-2034-4871-5496-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
Repeat.

413-2781-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

323-5170-5256-6132.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3609-4153-7067.description:
Activate Fire Nation Turret by paying {R}, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat step 1 two additional times.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all charge counters from Fire Nation Turret onto Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
3609-4153-7067.notes: If you have additional {R} available, you can put more counters on Fire Nation Turret before activating Resourceful Defense. This will put extra counters on Magistrate's Scepter, which may allow you to skip straight to step 4 on subsequent turns.

826-997-2178-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

141-2921-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

1850-1863-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-1863-6620.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

222-308-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

372-961-1018.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-1018.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

372-2072-2556.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2072-2556.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

190-389-6124-6126.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Herald of Eternal Dawn.
Cast Merciless Eviction by paying its mana cost, exiling all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

3923-4050-5851.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U}{U} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters you control
3923-4050-5851.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
If you control at least 6 Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Stormsplitter tokens, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.

943-4235-4552-5343.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the nonland card
943-4235-4552-5343.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one nonland card in hand.
943-4235-4552-5343.description:
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve the copy of Deserted Temple's ability, untapping it.
Activate Deserted Temple by tapping it, adding two mana of any color and causing the next spell you cast this turn to have cascade.
Resolve the Deserted Temple ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.
Cast any nonland card from your hand by paying its mana cost, causing you to get infinite cascade triggers based off the mana value of that spell.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor

1430-1558-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating three Food, three Clue, and three Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

190-389-4157.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, cast Patrician's Scorn by paying {0}, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

4188-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Accomplished Alchemist.
Accomplished Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
4188-4222.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist's second ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

1295-1832-2428-4277-5042.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You have an even number of cards in library.
Your life total is at least 2.
1295-1832-2428-4277-5042.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and one life, causing you to draw two cards and discard a card, ensuring not to discard Thassa's Oracle if it's in your hand.
Horizon Chimera triggers twice, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling any card from your hand except Thassa's Oracle if it's in your hand, adding {B/G}{B/G}.
Repeat until you have an empty library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
